claims.statement: The wallet aggregate (internal/domain/wallet/) is self-contained: types (WalletPayment, WalletTopup, WalletBalance, WalletIPN), WalletService interface, repository interfaces scoped inside the aggregate (not in ports/), and forecast types all live together.
WalletTopup has no status field because top-ups are confirmed on insert (the actual top-up is done via bank app); the row is the immutable audit record.

The wallet payment state machine uses github.com/qmuntal/stateless with states pending → verified → authorised → completed | failed | reversed and triggers verify, reject, authorise, ipn_completed, ipn_failed, ipn_reversed; completed/failed/reversed are terminal.
Only IPN-driven transitions reach terminal state in production; status_inquiry_worker and disbursement_poller_worker are the safety net for missed webhooks.

Settlement carries a SettlementUUID unique-indexed as an idempotency key for async processing; Validate enforces transaction_id required, amount > 0, settlement_date not in the future (date-only comparison), and created_by required.

AccountingRules.ValidateTransactionGroup and ValidateBalancedTransaction enforce that the sum of debits equals the sum of credits across ledger groups; the rules are verified by property-based tests using gopter (accounting_rules_test.go).
The cash-readiness and demand forecast are statistical (ADR-010) and advisory only: the response is DISPLAY ONLY and must not feed SyncBalance or any auto top-up.

Reliability fields (reliability_state, calibration_samples, WAPE, bias, interval coverage, reserve shortfall rate) are measured only from unfiltered company forecasts resolved against distinct timesheets in generated weekly transfer files; filtered forecasts are never mixed into company accuracy.

9Pay reconciliation is matched against wallet_payments only (not against manual settlements) and the monthly reconciliation report covers the cycle window from the 16th of the previous month through the 15th of the current month.
